doc: Camera feel (core/render/README.md). modes: the screen scale per situation (ppm = screen px per metre; F-13: 32 on foot, 48 in a car, about 64 in boss arenas). A mode change eases the zoom over zoom_ease_ticks (smoothstep, 60 Hz sim ticks). look_ahead_m_per_mps leads the camera along the velocity, capped at look_ahead_max_m, eased by look_ahead_ease per tick. shakes: amplitude in screen px decaying linearly over ticks at freq_hz (a hash of the tick, no RNG stream); hitstops: ticks the game freezes on an impact (fx_triggers.json `hitstop` names the row; SimClock.hold withholds that much frame time, no tick changes), at most one per hitstop_cooldown_ticks. reduced_motion scales shake and look-ahead and lengthens the zoom ease.
